notes.title: v1.2 Summer Update
notes.content:
Your Review Matters!
Hey everyone, if you’ve played President 47, we’d really appreciate it if you could take a moment to leave us a review here on Steam. Reviews help a ton by giving us valuable feedback to keep improving. Thanks so much for your support!  
[hr][/hr]

Update Notes
We’ve been hard at work making improvements to President 47, and here’s what’s new in this update:

 
Language Support
The game is now translated into multiple languages so more players around the world can join the fight for freedom!
 
Bug Fixes & Improvements
Minor polish and quality-of-life updates across the board. 



[hr][/hr]

Thank you all for playing President 47 and sharing your feedback. Stay tuned—more updates and new content are on the way!

notes.title: 🏛️ 2028 Expansion Out Now — 50% Off!
notes.content:
🏛️ 2028 Expansion Out Now — 50% Off! 🗳️

Prepare your campaign. The stakes have never been higher.

The all-new "2028 Mission" is here, and it's our most challenging update yet. A new mode puts you in the chaos of the 2028 elections, where:

 Difficulty is vastly increased
 You start each level with a random weapon
 Strategic adaptability is the only way to survive
 Brute force is the only way 


Also included:
✅ New achievement added (Empty hands)
✅ Grace of God achievement fixed

💥 To celebrate the update, the game is now 50% OFF!
Whether you're a seasoned candidate or a first-time fighter, there's never been a better time to jump in.
